title: Track Lighting Installation: Two-Circuit Track with App-Controlled Heads
summary: The video demonstrates installing a linear track lighting system powered from an existing outlet, using a two-circuit track that allows independent control of light heads. The host covers wiring power to the track, concealing wiring with surface raceway and back clips, routing around corners with Flex conduit, and mounting the track to a ceiling beam with screws. It also shows dimming the heads and explains how the two circuits can be controlled either by a separate switch or via a mobile app, with the later segment highlighting Bluetooth-enabled fixtures that enable lighting control and music playback from a phone. Throughout, the steps emphasize practical wiring, mounting hardware, and the interaction between physical controls and app-based features.
topics: wire concealment on brick and ceiling

sections.title: Track basics and power delivery
sections.description: Introduction to the linear track and how power is fed from one end to supply hot and neutral along the length of the track; explanation that each light fixture requires hot and neutral and that a two-circuit track can split control across heads.

sections.title: Wiring concealment with surface raceway
sections.description: Switching to conceal the wire, using surface raceway with special back clips to attach to brick and ceiling, enabling neat routing of wiring.

sections.title: Power connection to track
sections.description: Power is wired to the track from the circuit, detailing neutral, hot, and ground connections and how a raceway connector fits into the track.

sections.title: Mounting the track on a beam
sections.description: Positioning the track on a beam, centering it, and securing sections with screws.

sections.title: Power up, dimming, and two-circuit behavior
sections.description: Power is restored; the track includes a dimmer control. The two-circuit system allows one set of heads to be on one circuit while another set is controlled separately.

sections.title: App-controlled lighting and Bluetooth features
sections.description: The fixtures support app-based control to turn lights on and dim them. The system also announces built-in Bluetooth functionality for music playback and phone control, highlighting a degree of smart-home integration.
